in_hebrew.name: Halda
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Halda הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word ‘halos’, meaning ‘ruler’ or ‘noblewoman’. In the New Testament, Halda may be related to the name Hadassah, which means ‘myrtle branch’, a symbol of strength and dedication.

in_greek.name: Halda
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Ruler, Noblewoman
in_greek.long_meaning: Halda είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word ‘halos’, meaning ‘ruler’ or ‘noblewoman’. In the New Testament, Halda may be related to the name Hadassah, which means ‘myrtle branch’, a symbol of strength and dedication.

in_latin.name: Halda
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Ruler, Noblewoman
in_latin.long_meaning: Halda est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word ‘halos’, meaning ‘ruler’ or ‘noblewoman’. In the New Testament, Halda may be related to the name Hadassah, which means ‘myrtle branch’, a symbol of strength and dedication.
